name: Mr. Aadil Sheikh
summary: Advancing modern orchard development, world-class fruit varieties and stronger connections between growers, technology and global horticultural partners.
biography:
Mr. Aadil Sheikh is the Chief Executive Officer of Zeebaran Services Private Limited, a company committed to transforming the horticulture landscape through innovation, technology and sustainable agricultural practices.

With a forward-looking vision for the future of horticulture, he is focused on advancing modern orchard development, introducing world-class fruit varieties and strengthening the connection between growers, technology providers and global horticultural partners.

Under his leadership, Zeebaran Services Private Limited strives to bring international expertise, scientific orchard management practices and innovative agricultural solutions to Kashmir, empowering farmers to improve productivity, fruit quality and long-term profitability.

His vision is to contribute to the evolution of Kashmir's horticulture sector by combining global opportunities with local agricultural potential, creating sustainable value for growers and building a stronger future for the region's fruit industry.
vision: Transforming orchards. Empowering farmers. Growing a better future.

name: Mr. Hilal Sheikh
summary: Leading high-density apple orchard development and scientific establishment, from layout and plantation planning to trellis systems and modern orchard management.
biography:
Mr. Hilal Sheikh leads the Orchard Management division at Zeebaran Services Private Limited, specialising in High-Density Apple Orchard Development and scientific orchard establishment.

With a strong focus on modern horticultural practices, he oversees the planning, development and establishment of high-density apple orchards, ensuring the effective implementation of modern orchard systems and infrastructure.

His area of specialisation includes orchard layout planning, plantation techniques, support and trellis systems, tree training and the systematic establishment of productive, sustainable orchards.

Through his expertise and commitment to operational excellence, he plays an important role in translating modern horticultural concepts into practical solutions for growers, contributing to the advancement of Kashmir's apple industry.

name: Dr. Auqib Nisar
summary: Bringing scientific approaches and precise field execution to orchard establishment, farm operations, advanced cultivation and sustainable crop management.
biography:
Dr. Auqib Nisar serves as Field-cum-Farm Manager at Zeebaran Services Private Limited, where he plays a key role in the implementation, supervision and management of modern horticultural operations.

Specialising in High-Density Apple Orchard Development, Advanced Horticultural Practices, Orchard Establishment, Farm Operations and Precision Crop Management, he brings a strong focus on scientific approaches and efficient field-level execution.

His responsibilities encompass coordinating orchard development activities, supervising farm operations, implementing advanced cultivation techniques and ensuring the effective adoption of modern horticultural practices. He is committed to translating scientific knowledge and innovative agricultural methods into practical solutions that enhance orchard productivity, fruit quality and operational efficiency.

Through his dedication to field excellence and sustainable farm management, he contributes to the company's mission of modernising Kashmir's horticulture sector and empowering growers with advanced orchard development solutions.

name: Mr. Mudasir Wani
summary: Coordinating people, resources and day-to-day operations to deliver reliable project execution, efficient workflows and consistently high standards of service.
biography:
Mr. Mudasir Wani serves as Head of Operations at Zeebaran Services Private Limited, overseeing the coordination and execution of the company's day-to-day operational activities.

He plays an important role in ensuring smooth business operations, effective resource management, team coordination and the timely execution of organisational objectives. His focus is on strengthening operational efficiency, streamlining workflows and maintaining high standards of service delivery across the company's activities.

Working closely with the management and field teams, he contributes to translating strategic plans into effective operational outcomes, supporting the company's commitment to professional excellence, quality execution and sustainable growth.

Through his dedication to operational management and organisational coordination, he helps drive Zeebaran Services Private Limited's mission of delivering reliable, technology-enabled horticultural solutions and advancing modern orchard development in Kashmir.

name: Mr. Arjumand Bhat
summary: Connecting Kashmir's horticulture industry with global nursery partners, premium planting material and sustainable domestic and international trade opportunities.
biography:
Mr. Arjumand Bhat leads Domestic and International Trade at Zeebaran Services Private Limited, focusing on expanding the company's business network, strengthening global partnerships and facilitating cross-border trade opportunities in the horticulture sector.

His role encompasses the development of domestic and international business relationships, coordination with global nurseries and suppliers, sourcing of premium fruit planting material and facilitating international trade operations.

With a strategic focus on connecting Kashmir's horticulture industry with global markets and technological advancements, he contributes to identifying new business opportunities, developing international collaborations and strengthening the availability of world-class horticultural resources for Indian growers.

He is committed to building sustainable trade relationships, promoting international cooperation and bringing global horticultural innovation closer to Kashmir's farming community.

name: Mr. Suhail Bhat
summary: Strengthening the organisational framework through effective administration, clear internal coordination, systematic records and dependable day-to-day office operations.
biography:
Mr. Suhail Bhat serves as Head of Administration at Zeebaran Services Private Limited, playing an important role in ensuring effective administrative management and organisational coordination.

He is responsible for supporting the company's administrative functions, maintaining organisational systems, coordinating internal activities and facilitating smooth day-to-day office operations.

With a focus on administrative efficiency, systematic management and organisational discipline, he contributes to creating a well-coordinated working environment that supports the company's operational and strategic objectives.

Through his commitment to professional administration and organisational effectiveness, he helps strengthen the internal framework of Zeebaran Services Private Limited and supports its continued growth in the horticulture sector.
